tools.name: map_create
tools.description: Create a map of places in the continental US. Returns map_id and map_url.

tools.name: map_get_state
tools.description: Read a map: lists, places, save_state, version, pending_changes.

tools.name: map_update
tools.description: Change a map's title, context, travel mode, interests, day noun or whether it routes between stops.

tools.name: map_edit_places
tools.description: Add, update, move, remove (park in rejected) or restore places. Each op result has the list_id and kind of the list it used.

tools.name: map_edit_lists
tools.description: Create, update (rename, change kind, pin a saved list to a plan list) or delete lists. A plan list's date goes in its name ("Sat, Oct 3 · Acadia"). Deleting a list moves its places to Unscheduled or to. Each op result has the list_id and kind of the list it used.

tools.name: map_search_places
tools.description: Find places and street addresses in the continental US for an existing map_id. Returns places and fields_granted per query.

tools.name: map_save
tools.description: Save a map to the traveler's account.

tools.name: map_list
tools.description: List the traveler's saved maps, and maps shared with them, with their map_id and map_url.

tools.name: map_share
tools.description: Create, list or revoke links that let other people view a saved map or join it as editors, change a link's role, or list and manage the people who joined.
